standard_prerequisites.use: Definition of weakly etale (flat plus flat diagonal, More on Morphisms definition section), stability of flat morphisms under base change and composition (Morphisms, lemmas base-change-flat and composition-flat), and the fibre-product identity for iterated diagonals.

core_obligations: Factor the Z-diagonal of X through the Y-diagonal and identify the second map as a base change.
Conclude flatness from the cited stability lemmas.
Assemble part (2) from part (1) and the definition.

proof_roadmap.step: Diagonal factorization X -> X x_Y X -> X x_Z X with the cartesian identity.
Composition of weakly etale via flat stability plus unramified composition.

difficulty_reason: For morphisms X -> Y -> Z of schemes the lemma proves two statements: if the absolute-ish diagonals X -> X x_Y X and Y -> Y x_Z Y are flat then the diagonal X -> X x_Z X is flat, and consequently a composition of weakly etale morphisms is weakly etale. The retained proof is written: part (1) factors the diagonal of X over Z as X -> X x_Y X -> X x_Z X, identifies X x_Y X as the fibre product (X x_Z X) x_{Y x_Z Y} Y so the second map is a base change of the flat diagonal of Y over Z, and concludes with the cited Morphisms-chapter lemmas that flatness is stable under base change and composition; part (2) adds the unramified half, which is Morphisms, lemma-unramified-composition, and the definition of weakly etale. Retained author proof at lines 18984-18999.

dedup.scope: Closure of weakly etale morphisms under composition, schemes side.
